card.title: How To Repair PS5 Controller Not Working in Normal Mode but Works in Safe Mode

source.title: How To Repair PS5 Controller Not Working in Normal Mode but Works in Safe Mode

symptoms: controller works only in Safe Mode
controller won't pair in normal mode

claims.statement: A DualSense that works in PS5 Safe Mode (via USB) but not in normal mode, after reset and firmware update and testing on another console, points to a faulty Wi-Fi/Bluetooth module on the main board.
Fix is replacing the board's Wi-Fi/BT module with an exact match.

procedure: Reset the controller; test via USB in Safe Mode and normal mode.
Test the controller on another PS5; update firmware.
card.caveats: Module locations per board revision are shown only in images. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
